statement: Let $n$ be an odd positive integer and $x_1, \ldots, x_n \geq 0$. Show that $\min_{i=1,\ldots,n}(x_i^2 + x_{i+1}^2) \leq \max_{j=1,\ldots,n}(2x_j x_{j+1})$ (indices mod $n$).

Let $ABCD$ be a cyclic quadrilateral. Diagonals $AC$ and $BD$ meet at $X$. Let $C_1, D_1, M$ be midpoints of $CX, DX, CD$. Lines $AD_1$ and $BC_1$ meet at $Y$; line $MY$ meets diagonals at $E$ and $F$. Prove line $XY$ is tangent to the circumcircle of $\triangle EFX$.
Consider a $4m \times 4m$ array. Two cells are related if they share a row or column. Some cells are blue so every cell is related to at least two blue cells. Find the minimum number of blue cells.

Two circles $\omega_1$ and $\omega_2$ of equal radius meet at $X_1$ and $X_2$. Circle $\omega$ is externally tangent to $\omega_1$ at $T_1$ and internally tangent to $\omega_2$ at $T_2$. Prove $X_1T_1$ and $X_2T_2$ intersect at a point on $\omega$.

Let $k \geq 2$ and $k \leq n \leq 2k-1$. Tile an $n \times n$ board with $1 \times k$ and $k \times 1$ tiles until no more can be placed. For each pair $(k, n)$, find the minimum number of tiles such an arrangement may contain.

Let $S$ be the set of positive integers $n$ such that $n^4$ has a divisor in $(n^2, n^2+2n]$. Prove there are infinitely many elements of $S$ of each of the forms $7m$, $7m+1$, $7m+2$, $7m+5$, $7m+6$, and no elements of the forms $7m+3$ and $7m+4$.
